'''Borvo's acklay''' was an [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]] owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was kept in [[Borvo's Vault]] near [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD" /> Borvo the Hutt has been raising exotic creatures for the sole purpose of creating a new armor for his personal army.<ref name="SWG:P28">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] entered the vault to retrieve an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|decentralized autonomy chip]] droid module.<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD" /> The spacer killed the acklay and took pieces of its carapace and gave them to the [[armorsmith]] [[Dakk]] who made a suit of [[acklay armor]] out of it.<ref name="SWG:FaA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Borvo's acklay appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Borvo's acklay was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> A secondary quest involving the acklay chest armor piece was later added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SWG:P28" />
